这个密钥来自环境变量，不能在这里清除；要换掉它，请改系统的环境变量。: This key comes from an environment variable and cannot be cleared here. To replace it, change the environment variable on your system.
边听边看简体中文，选中重点就能出题。: Follow along in Simplified Chinese and turn key passages into questions.
选择正在播放课程的标签页，并勾选「共享标签页音频」。只发送声音，不发送画面。: Select the class tab and enable “Share tab audio”. Only audio is sent, never video.
转写使用 Gemini；简体中文翻译使用音频设置中选定的模型。免费额度用完会切到: Gemini transcribes audio; the model chosen in audio settings translates it. When free quota runs out, the paid key is used.
原文在上，简体中文在下；勾选句子或划选文字即可出题。: Original above, Simplified Chinese below. Check sentences or highlight text to make questions.
开始说话后，原文和译文会出现在这里。: The transcript and translation appear here when speech is detected.
这场实录还没有文字。: This recording has no transcript yet.
再多选约 {0} 个字符才能出题: select about {0} more characters to create questions
至少约 {0} 个原文字符，目前 {1}: At least about {0} original characters; now {1}
已加入出题任务；课堂实录会继续。草稿会出现在「学习库 › 待发布草稿」，进度在「: Question generation started; recording continues. The draft will appear in Library › Drafts to publish, with live progress in Jobs.
已加入校对任务，完成后会保存为资料。: Proofreading queued; the result will be saved as a source.
暂无未归档课堂。实录会自动保存在当前学习库。: No unarchived classes. Recordings are saved automatically in this study library.
每批校正后更新；下一批参考累计摘要与最近笔记。点句子编号可回看原文。: Updated after each correction batch; the next batch uses the summary and recent notes. Select a reference to return to the transcript.
首批校正完成后，这里会出现课堂摘要。: The class summary appears after the first correction batch.
有新的课程要点时自动记录。: New learning points will be recorded here.
使用音频设置中选择的文字模型在后台处理，实录与逐批校正继续进行。未完成的请求会保: Processed in the background using the text model selected in audio settings, while recording and batch correction continue. Incomplete requests remain available for retry.
请确认课程正在播放，并已勾选共享音频；检查播放器是否静音。: Check that the class is playing, audio sharing is enabled, and the player is not muted.
对着麦克风说话，观察音量条。如果一直不动，请检查系统输入设备、静音开关和麦克风距: Speak toward the microphone and watch the meter. If it stays still, check your system input, mute switch and microphone distance.
请调低系统输入音量或离麦克风远一点，避免声音失真。: Lower the system input volume or move farther from the microphone to avoid distortion.
浏览器没有持续送来音频。请检查设备或共享状态，必要时结束后重新开始。: The browser is not delivering audio continuously. Check the device or sharing status; end and restart if needed.
部分请求未报告输出 Token: Some calls did not report output tokens
付费通道 · 余额请查看供应商控制台: Paid route · check the provider for credit balance
有额度响应后自动显示，或查看供应商控制台: Shown when a quota response is available; check the provider console
付费余额请查看供应商控制台: Check the provider console for credit balance
未知额度不会显示为零；可查看供应商控制台。: Unknown quota is not zero. Check the provider console.
从 AI Studio 填入当前模型的 RPD。Gemini 同项目共享额度，这: Enter each model’s RPD from AI Studio. Gemini quotas are shared by project; usage here covers this plugin only. 0 means unknown.
勾选句子或划选文字即可出题。: Tick sentences or select text to make questions.
正在听写，句子说完后会定稿: Listening; the sentence is finalized once it ends
等第一句说完后开始润色: Polishing starts once the first sentence ends
每 30 秒检查一次新句子，按顺序分批，并带上前面几句作上下文；结束后补齐剩余内: New sentences are checked every 30 seconds, in order and in batches, with the sentences before them as context; what is left is checked when the class ends. A sentence gets a green dot only when the model changed it with high confidence: a solid dot means polished, a ring means checked and left as it was.
模型给出但没能用的内容: What the model returned but could not be used
选中最近约 {0} 个原文字符的内容: Select the latest {0} characters or so of the class
先选几句话；至少约 120 个原文字符才能出题: Select some sentences first; about 120 characters of source text are needed to make questions
一次最多选 400 句: Select at most 400 sentences at a time
已保存文字稿和课堂笔记。: Saved the transcript and the class notes.
已保存文字稿，但没有保存课堂笔记：没有可用的文字模型，或模型没有给出可用的笔记。: Saved the transcript, but no class notes were saved: there is no text model to make them, or the model gave nothing usable.
声音发送跟不上，请检查网络: Sound is not being sent fast enough; check your network
最近几秒没有确认听到声音: No confirmation of sound in the last few seconds
音量条显示电脑实际收到的声音；收到声音不等于已经转成文字。: The meter shows the sound the computer actually received; receiving sound does not mean it has been turned into text.
保存为资料时会另存一份课堂笔记；润色没能整理出笔记时，会改用文字稿整理一份。: Saving as a source also saves class notes; if the polish made none, they are written from the transcript.
保存时会先补完润色和译文，再存下文字稿和课堂笔记；没能做完的，会在任务里说明。: Saving first finishes the polish and the translations, then keeps the transcript and the class notes; anything it could not finish is explained in Tasks.
已加入保存任务：先补完润色和译文，再保存。进度在任务里，完成后在资料里打开。: Save queued: it finishes the polish and the translations first, then saves. Follow it in Tasks; open the result in Sources.
再校对一遍整份文字、按段翻译并起标题，需要文字模型，比较慢；一般点「保存为资料」: Proofreads the whole text once more, translates it part by part and titles it. Needs a text model and is slower; saving the class as a source is usually enough.
润色已暂停，点「重试待校正内容」再继续。: Polish is paused; choose “Retry pending correction” to continue.
到音频设置换一个文字模型: Choose another text model in Audio settings
结束后点「保存为资料」，会先补完润色和译文，再存下文字稿和课堂笔记。: After the class, choose “Save as source”: it finishes the polish and the translations first, then keeps the transcript and the class notes.
